name: RaySearch Laboratories AB (publ)
summary: RaySearch Laboratories AB (publ), a medical technology company, provides software solutions for cancer treatment worldwide. It offers RayStation, a treatment planning system for cancer centers; RayCare, an oncology information system for clinics; RayIntelligence, cloud-based oncology analytics system that cancer centers can use to gather, structure and analyze data; and RayCommand, a treatment control system designed to link the treatment machine and the treatment planning and oncology information systems.
